As announced in partnership with NVIDIA at CES , we’re excited to introduce Stable Point Aware 3D (SPAR3D), setting a new standard in 3D generation. Ideal for running on NVIDIA RTX AI PCs, SPAR3D enables real-time editing and complete structure generation of 3D objects from a single image in under a second. You can download the weights on Hugging Face and code on GitHub , or access the model through the Stability AI Developer Platform API . Where the model excels SPAR3D transforms 3D prototyping for game developers, product designers, and environment builders with the following advanced capabilities: Unprecedented Control : Allows users to directly edit the point cloud by deleting, duplicating, stretching, adding features, or recoloring points. Complete Structure Prediction : Enhances 3D construction by providing accurate geometry and detailed predictions for full 360-degree views, including areas typically hidden, such as the back of an object. Lightning-Fast Generation : Converts edited point clouds into final meshes in just 0.3 seconds, enabling seamless real-time editing. From a single input image, it generates highly detailed 3D meshes in only 0.7 seconds per object. A first-of-its-kind architecture SPAR3D's architecture combines precise point cloud sampling with advanced mesh generation to deliver unprecedented control over 3D asset creation. The process works in two stages: First Stage: A specialized point diffusion model generates a detailed point cloud capturing the object's fundamental structure. Second Stage: The triplane transformer processes this point cloud alongside the original image features, producing high-resolution triplane data. This data drives the final reconstruction, accurately capturing geometry, texture, and illumination from the source image. This dual-stage approach uniquely combines regression-based modeling's precision with generative techniques' flexibility, enabling both accurate reconstruction and creative control. This advanced architecture ensures precise geometry and accurate 360-degree predictions, streamlining 3D modeling workflows.
